items.text: Eagles WRs DeVonta Smith (hamstring) and Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) ruled OUT for Monday Night vs. Cowboys.
items.why: Official injury report and Schefter/Rapoport confirmation via beat.
items.implication: Thin Eagles WR room; elevated targets for remaining options and TE Dallas Goedert in MNF spot.
items.opportunity: Goedert and any available slot/depth WRs see route/target bump; monitor A.J. Brown if applicable but roster notes NE.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson (ankle/high-ankle sprain) downgraded to OUT for Sunday vs. Bengals; Tyler Huntley starts again.
items.why: Downgraded Saturday after earlier optimism and limited practice; high-ankle sprain.
items.implication: Huntley start caps Ravens pass game and rushing upside; fade Lamar-dependent pieces, consider Huntley streaming only in deep formats.
items.opportunity: Increased work for Mark Andrews/Isaiah Likely in short area; Derrick Henry volume stable but less explosive offense.

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua (calf) listed QUESTIONABLE; minor per reports, will test pregame after limited/DNP practices; McVay notes lack of power/explosion.
items.why: Calf issue emerged Thursday practice; described as minor but no Friday practice, pregame workout planned.
items.implication: True GTD; if out, major Rams pass-game downgrade with Adams already out. Rank range WR1 to OUT.
items.opportunity: If OUT: Tyler Higbee leads targets, then Mumpfield/Parkinson/Atwell hierarchy per Levitan.

items.text: Packers RB Josh Jacobs activated from exempt list and expected to play Sunday; ETR listed IN.
items.implication: Immediate RB2/flex with full role expected post-layoff; reverse any backup elevation.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (hamstring) QUESTIONABLE but expected to play Monday vs. Cowboys after full/limited practices and return from two-game absence.
items.why: Progressed to full participant Saturday; team and reports lean active.
items.implication: If active, immediate RB1 restart vs. DAL; Berry/Stephania agree insert if playing.
items.opportunity: Full bellcow snaps/carries/redzone if cleared; reverse any handcuff elevation.

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall (quad) QUESTIONABLE after limited practices Thu/Fri following three missed games; ~50/50, true GTD vs. MIA.
items.why: Returned limited after DNP Wed; matchup strong but snap share uncertain if active.
items.implication: Berry starts if plays; otherwise Braelon Allen RB1 upside. Monitor early Sunday.
items.opportunity: If OUT: full work to backup; if limited IN: committee risk.

items.text: OUTs include Emeka Egbuka, David Montgomery, Tyler Warren, Rashee Rice, Davante Adams, Mike Evans, Deebo Samuel, Jeremiyah Love, Zach Charbonnet, Brian Robinson (plus others); IN/expected: Jacobs, Judkins, Addison, etc.
items.why: ETR early Sunday dump corroborated by Schefter full outs list.
items.implication: Clear benches; identify handcuffs/beneficiaries (e.g. Judkins IN, backups for Montgomery/Love).
items.opportunity: Quinshon Judkins elevated; GB/others without Charbonnet etc.; reverse stale for any unexpected INs.

items.text: If Saquon Barkley is out there vs. Cowboys, he goes right back into fantasy lineups (agrees with Stephania Bell).
items.why: Return from hamstring; proven producer, insert immediately if active.
items.implication: Must-start RB1 if cleared for MNF.

items.text: If Puka Nacua (calf) can't go, Stafford hierarchy: 1. Tyler Higbee 2. Konata Mumpfield 3. Colby Parkinson 4. Tutu Atwell 5. Jordan Whittington 6. Davis Allen.
items.why: Adams already IR; thin WR room forces TE/slot elevation.
items.implication: Higbee becomes priority TE1/WR flex dart if Puka inactive.
items.opportunity: Higbee routes/targets spike; secondary pieces for DFS.

items.text: Brian Robinson (hamstring) OUT; Bijan Robinson full workload vs. SF, whose DvP inflates opposing RB production 4.4% (7th-most).
items.why: Official OUT; SF recent RB receptions/TDs high (White, Holani, Harvey, Love examples).
items.implication: Elite Bijan spot for carries + receiving; full bellcow.

items.text: Colston Loveland BACK with Caleb Williams: 30% target share, 19.2 PPR/game, 6+ rec and 60+ yards in both games since return.
items.why: Sustained high target share and production with starting QB.
items.implication: Strong TE1/TE2 start; every-week option while volume holds.

items.text: George Kittle will go nuts Sunday: scheme + entire 49ers WR corps hurt (Evans/Deebo out); ignore 'National TE Day' narrative.
items.why: WR injuries force funnel to Kittle; CMC may see more slot per comments (though Levitan skeptical of RB-as-WR generally, tempted here).
items.implication: Kittle elite TE1; CMC receiving upside elevated.
items.opportunity: Kittle target share/routes spike; CMC slot snaps possible.
items.conflict: Rarely buys RB WR alignment hype but situation dire.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson played just 21% snaps over last three weeks; major role downgrade.
items.why: Persistent low snap share indicates committee/backup status.
items.implication: Sit/flex only in deep leagues; handcuff value only.

items.text: Luther Burden only 68.8% routes but elite 2.56 YPRR; Kmet injury may reduce 2-/3-TE sets, giving Burden more juice.
items.why: Efficiency elite on limited routes; teammate TE absence expands role.
items.implication: Sneaky WR upside/breakout candidate with higher route share.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets in Bears offense with Caleb back.
